articles.title: Braves-Phillies wild-card preview: Who prevails in rivals’ third playoff clash in 5 years?
articles.description: The Braves and Phillies, familiar foes in the regular season and playoffs, will square off again in a tantalizing matchup.

articles.title: Braves went off script, but following their blueprint is key to a postseason run
articles.description: Atlanta cannot afford to waste Sale’s starts. All season, the team gave him extra rest so he could be at his best.

articles.title: Ronald Acuña Jr. has a ring but playing in a World Series is still on his bucket list
articles.description: Acuña loves to bring joy to the people who watch his teams. He hopes to play a big role in bringing Braves fans more joy in the playoffs.

articles.title: After grinding all year, Austin Riley’s wild-card homer takes pressure off Braves
articles.description: "To finally come up big for the team was huge," Riley said after his go-ahead home run in Game 1 of the Wild Card Series.

articles.title: Braves Bulletin: JR Ritchie another option as postseason pitching picture takes shape
articles.description: Plus notes on Robert Suarez's return to the bullpen and how the Braves could deploy the relief corps in October.

articles.title: Another Phillies postseason, another painful round of ‘what-ifs’ about the bullpen
articles.description: Three years, three Game 1s, three blown leads in the seventh inning or later. After another soul-crushing loss, the season is on the line.

articles.title: Braves’ Grant Holmes, after years of waiting and working, is ready for October
articles.description: Holmes, entering his first postseason with a 3.44 ERA, is validating the Braves' bet on him and Atlanta's rotation.

articles.title: How the Braves and Royals are capitalizing on the growing game-used memorabilia market
articles.description: Truist Park's new specialty memorabilia shop and museum opened this season to serve growing demand for game-used everything.

articles.title: Braves place Martín Pérez on injured list 6 days before postseason
articles.description: The Braves hope he can return this postseason, but the injury is a blow for the lefty who is having one of the best seasons of his career.

articles.title: Phillies come alive to avoid historic collapse, clinch playoff date with Braves
articles.description: It took until the 162nd game of the season, with an existential crisis baked into the final week, but the Phillies are back in the playoffs.
